workbuddy.installSource: WorkBuddy local upload of the GitHub v1.1.19 formal package

verification.packageFunctionalTests: Python package/module checks and JavaScript collector/browser-DOM checks passed, including clean-package runtime preparation
verification.workbuddyOfflineAcceptance: prepare-runtime returned installedVersion 1.1.19 and installed_version_test.py passed on the actual WorkBuddy tree

v113ScoringAndReportSemantics.basis: Coverage counts answered claims independently from evidence sufficiency. A point is excluded from coverage and accuracy denominators only when every selected platform omitted it or lacked sufficient evidence. Internally distinct unsupported states remain traceable while the user-facing category is 疑似误导. Stage four consumes the locked stage-three result without recomputing it.

v113SourceAndTechnicalEvidence.basis: Government-anchor downgrades are conservative and non-symmetric, Qwen direct-source body capture is covered by regression tests, long evidence is folded by default, and technical acquisition failures are displayed in every report stage.

v114DoubaoSourceCountBoundary.basis: Doubao platform-declared counts and auditable page links are retained separately. A 21-declared/16-auditable difference is nonblocking after all exposed links are captured, while an unopened source surface and cited PDF without verifiable body remain fail-closed.

v115ArtifactsSourcesAndRecommendations.basis: Existing stage artifacts expose native paths plus standards-compliant file URIs and Markdown links, portable packages remove host paths, DKnow inline and knowledge-library sources preserve scope without duplicate counting, and recommendation-only points remain outside factual verification metrics.

v116DoubaoComposerAndDknowExtraction.basis: The Doubao adapter locates the TipTap/ProseMirror composer with a visible contenteditable fallback; an authenticated page without a chat input reports input_not_found with adapter-drift guidance instead of login_required; captured DKnow answers exclude elements not rendered on the live page, including the collapsed reasoning panel, thinking-status labels and the knowledge-library button. Real-browser regressions fail on the v1.1.15 collector and pass on v1.1.16; all ten archived DKnow capture pages replay without hidden text.

v117FootnoteResolutionAndDeepTraceCaptur.basis: References merge on citation identity rather than URL alone, so every marker of a multi-marker source document stays resolvable; a marker's platform mirror and originating government URL merge into one reference keeping the external address; hidden deep-trace progress placeholders are never returned as answers and placeholder or near-empty DKnow answers are not recorded as successful captures. Replaying twelve archived DKnow pages raises marker coverage from 185/269 (68.8%) on v1.1.16 to 269/269 (100%); the same replay on v1.1.14 yields 269/270 (99.6%), locating the defect in v1.1.15.

v118ReadableEvidenceAndInstalledVersion.basis: Percent-encoded DKnow evidence text is decoded per contiguous escape run, so a truncated trailing sequence leaves only that fragment untouched and text without a paired escape signature is unchanged. Replaying ten archived DKnow pages reduces encoded evidence fields from 22/305 to 0/305, all of them deep-trace captures. prepare-runtime returns installedVersion with the executing package's version and its source file, taken from the running script's own directory. Scoring is unchanged.

v119SelectorRecoveryAndAuthorityReopen.basis: Doubao progress text is rejected as a final answer; selector drift can produce a proposal only after deterministic validation; one capture lifecycle submits the question at most once; authoritativeFinding is preserved verbatim; and finalized authority data can be corrected only through a hash-verified archive-and-reopen transaction. Playwright remains the driver, while the host browser or Computer Use is the primary recovery path and agent-browser is optional diagnostic input.

publishGate.blockingReason: v1.1.19 is published on GitHub, submitted to SkillHub for platform review, and installed in WorkBuddy; subsequent product changes require a new version.
